messages:
kevin: Heads-up 10.12 relnotes draft needs a quick smoke check. Found 3 places where snippets still show `RedwoodClient` global instead of the new `redwood.infer` surface. PR 544 has fixes but I want another pair of eyes.

nora: I can scan. Where are the occurrences?

kevin: whats-new/0.12.md, migration/cli-to-sdk.md, and snippets/gallery/py/streaming.md.

sylvie: Small notefor streaming.md the team agreed to recommend `on_delta` not `on_token` and to show a tiny compatibility shim. We should ensure the relnotes mention the shim so readers can find it.

ci-bot: snippet-tests INFO  running gallery checks for PR 544...

ci-bot: snippet-tests WARN  py/streaming.md uses attribute access; test harness running pinned SDK returns dicts. See CI note.

nora: Can we update the streaming snippet to be defensive: `token_text = d.get('token') or getattr(d, 'token', '')`? Keeps example short and works both ways.

kevin: Good. Add that and a one-line migration table mapping `--txt -> input`, `--stream -> on_delta`. Keep the relnotes short and link to the SDK changelog PR (#538).

product-bot: Product asks for a one-line, customer-facing blurb about "Adaptive routing". Keep non-technical and link to internal roadmap.

sylvie: Drafted: "Adaptive routing routes requests to the best available model variant to balance cost and latency; see internal roadmap for more."

ci-bot: snippet-tests PASS  gallery examples in PR 544 now pass under Node 18 and Python 3.11.

qa-liz: I'll check the deploy-preview once merged. Also noticed a tiny typo in whats-new frontmatter (release_date format). I'll patch that in a follow-up commit.

kevin: Thanks. After merged please ping me and I'll schedule the publish job to run in the release window.

nora: Merged the fixes, CI green, preview at https://docs.redwood.ai/preview/0.12.

qa-liz: Preview verified. The migration table renders on mobile and code blocks highlight. Thumbs from QA.

kevin: Publishing queued. Filing follow-up to add a short appendix in the SDK changelog with CLI->SDK flag equivalences (RED-2102). Closing thread."
